name: DSNR: GCE warmup + conf-weighted truncated CE
tagline: GCE warmup, smooth GCE -> CE transition, confidence-ratio per-sample weighting and progressive top-loss truncation up to the assumed poison rate.
formula: $$\mathcal{L}(\epsilon) = \frac{1}{|\mathcal{K}|}\sum_{i \in \mathcal{K}} w_i\,\big[(1-t)\,\mathrm{GCE}_q(p_i) + t\,\mathrm{CE}(p_i, y_i)\big],\;\; t = \min\!\big(1, \tfrac{\epsilon - W}{T_{\rm tr}}\big),\;\; w_i = \mathrm{clamp}\!\big(p_{i,y_i}/\max_c p_{i,c},\; \max(0.1, 1{-}0.9\,\pi),\; 1\big),\;\; \pi = \min(1,(\epsilon - W)/T_{\rm tr})$$

key_hyperparams.name: transition_epochs
key_hyperparams.role: linear blend GCE -> CE after warmup

key_hyperparams.name: max_truncation
key_hyperparams.role: fraction of highest-CE samples dropped at full ramp

key_hyperparams.name: truncation_ramp
key_hyperparams.role: epochs to reach max_truncation and full reweighting

init_recovers: GCE during warmup; CE when t=1, weights=1 and truncation=0
diff_from_baseline: Combines the generalized_ce baseline (warmup), a smooth blend into the cross_entropy baseline, then adds a confidence-ratio reweighting and a progressive top-loss-truncation step keyed to the assumed poison rate.

name: Bootstrap + confident-mistake penalty
tagline: Soft-bootstrapped CE with a linearly decayed mixing coefficient, plus a quadratic penalty on confidently wrong predictions exceeding a threshold.
formula: $$\mathcal{L} = -\overline{\sum_c \big(\beta(\epsilon)\,y_c + (1-\beta(\epsilon))\,p_c^{\rm sg}\big)\,\log p_c} + \lambda\,\overline{\mathbf{1}[\hat p > \tau \wedge \hat y \ne y]\,(\hat p - \tau)^2},\quad \beta(\epsilon) = \max(\beta_{end},\; \beta_0 - (\beta_0 - \beta_{end})\,\epsilon/E)$$

key_hyperparams.name: conf_thresh
key_hyperparams.role: threshold above which a wrong prediction is penalized

init_recovers: bootstrap baseline at beta=1 with lambda=0
diff_from_baseline: Generalises the bootstrap baseline by linearly decaying beta from 1.0 to 0.2 over training, and adds a (max-prob - tau)^2 penalty applied only when the argmax disagrees with the given label and the model is confident.

name: ARCP: relative-conf weighted bootstrap
tagline: Bootstrapped CE with linearly decayed mixing, weighted per-sample by clamp(p_y / (0.8 * mean p_y), 1) so very-low-confidence samples cap their gradient.
init_recovers: bootstrap baseline at beta=1.0 (equivalent to CE) and weights=1
diff_from_baseline: Combines bootstrap with a relative-confidence weight (anti-focal): each sample's CE is multiplied by min(p_y / (0.8 * batch-mean p_y), 1), capping the gradient on samples that fall below 80% of the batch-average confidence.

name: Inverse-flip target correction
tagline: GCE warmup, then targets are softly mixed with the inverse-flip class (y-1) mod C using sigmoid evidence on detached probs, plus self-bootstrap and confidence-x-decisiveness sample weights.
formula: $$\tilde y = (1 - r\,c\,s)\,e_y + r\,c\,s\,e_{(y-1)\bmod C},\;\; s = \sigma\!\big(\tfrac{(p_{prev}-p_y)/(p_{prev}+p_y) - \delta}{T}\big)\cdot\tfrac{p_{prev}}{p_{\max}},\;\;\mathcal{L} = (1{-}\mu r)\,\overline{w\,(-\sum \tilde y \log p)}/\overline{w} + \mu r\,\mathrm{GCE}_q$$

key_hyperparams.name: q (GCE)
key_hyperparams.role: GCE exponent during warmup and tail

key_hyperparams.name: gce_mix
key_hyperparams.role: ramped GCE residual on observed label

init_recovers: generalized_ce baseline during warmup; CE-style on observed label when correction strength s = 0
diff_from_baseline: Beyond cross_entropy / generalized_ce / bootstrap baselines, exploits the deterministic label-flip y -> (y+1) mod C: softly redirects targets to (y-1) mod C using an explicit sigmoid evidence score on detached probabilities, combines with light self-bootstrap and a confidence x decisiveness weight, and blends in a small GCE residual.
